headline: Home page redesign — hero, product cards, friendlier empty state
summary: The default storefront home page gains a confident, accessible hero with a primary CTA that anchors to the product grid below. Product cards render an image-ready 4:3 media area with an accent SKU badge, prominent accent-colored price, and a fully-clickable tile that lifts on hover. The empty state now points the operator at the admin API instead of dead-ending with one line of italic copy.

items.title: Home hero section
items.body: `HOME_HERO` renders an `<h1>` with a clamped responsive type scale, an eyebrow tag, an accent-highlighted word in the headline, a primary CTA (`Explore shop ↓`) that anchors to `#products` directly above the grid, and a secondary `View source` link. A subtle dual-radial gradient adds depth without clip-art. The hero collapses to a single column under 640px with stacked CTAs.

items.title: Product card
items.body: `PRODUCT_CARD` now renders a 4:3 media area (image-ready — falls back to an initials placeholder when the catalog row carries no media), an accent SKU badge in the top-left, a Montserrat-600 title, an accent-colored price with tabular numerals, and a `View product →` cue. The entire card is a single anchor, so the whole tile is clickable. Hover state lifts the card -3px with a soft shadow and shifts the arrow 2px — wrapped in `@media (prefers-reduced-motion: no-preference)` so motion-averse visitors see only the border-color change.

items.title: Friendlier empty state
items.body: `renderHome` with zero products now renders a dashed-border, centered panel: `No products yet` headline plus copy that points the operator at `POST /admin/products`. The hero still renders above the empty panel so first visitors see the framework identity even before the catalog is seeded.

items.title: Graceful null-price handling
items.body: When a product has no current price row, the card shows an em-dash in muted text (via `product-card__price--unset`) instead of leaking `null` or breaking the layout. The price class is set inline from `renderHome` based on whether `starting_price_minor` is present.

items.title: Layer 1 — home hero + card surface
items.body: `test/layer-1-state/storefront.test.js` gains a `_homeHero` cluster that asserts the hero is rendered with an `<h1>`, the headline copy is intact, the accent class wraps `open-source`, the primary CTA reads `Explore shop` and anchors to `#products`, and the grid anchor target exists. `_homeEmpty` now asserts the friendlier copy and the admin-API hint. A new `_homeMissingPrice` test exercises the `starting_price_minor: null` path.
